info.name: Chowa Clinic API
info.description:
Front desk API for Chowa Physio & Dental Care.

1. Import this collection and the "Chowa local" environment, select the environment.
2. Set `password` in the environment (the admin password from the seed).
3. Run the folders in order (Runner > Run collection), or send requests one by one.

Run it against a development or test database: it creates a doctor, a patient, invoices and a staff login.
Money is in poisha (৳1 = 100). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD clinic days (Asia/Dhaka).
Errors look like `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`.

item.name: 1. Sign in
item.description: Health check and login. Login saves the access token used by every other request (collection auth: Bearer {{accessToken}}).

request.description: Returns `{ user, accessToken }` and sets the httpOnly `chowa_rt` refresh cookie (path `/api/auth`). Access tokens last 15 minutes; 10 failed logins per 15 minutes per IP are allowed.
Uses the `chowa_rt` cookie (Postman keeps it from Login). The refresh token rotates on every call.

item.name: 2. Clinic setup
item.description: Reads departments, services and plans, and creates a fresh doctor so the queue starts at serial 1. Admin only for the writes.

exec: pm.test('an all-department plan exists', function () { pm.expect(plans.length).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: Replaces the whole week. `dayOfWeek`: 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday. Overlapping blocks on one day are rejected.

item.name: 3. Walk-in visit & queue
item.description: Register + book in one request, then run the doctor's queue. `Next` always sends the appointment the screen shows in the room; a stale screen gets 409 instead of skipping a patient.

exec: // A random new mobile number for this run
pm.test('no patient with this phone yet', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().patients).to.have.length(0); });
pm.test('serial 1 for a fresh doctor', function () { pm.expect(body.appointment.serialNo).to.eql(1); });

request.description: Send `patientId` instead of `newPatient` for an existing patient. Returns the patient ID (CPD-000123), the serial number and `warnings` (e.g. doctor not scheduled today).

exec: var mine = pm.response.json().doctors.find(function (d) { return d.practitioner.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('doctorId'); });
pm.test('our doctor has 1 waiting', function () { pm.expect(mine.waitingCount).to.eql(1); });

request.description: Poll every few seconds for the "Now serving" strip. Filters: `date`, `departmentId`.

exec: pm.test('our patient is in the room', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().calledId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('appointmentId')); });

request.description: The screen still thinks the doctor is free, but a patient is in the room: refused so nobody is skipped.

item.name: 4. Billing
item.description: Invoice the visit with a part payment, then collect the rest. Amounts are in poisha (৳1 = 100).

exec: pm.test('services pre-filled from the visit', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().items).to.have.length(2); });

request.description: Leave out `items` to bill the visit's services. Member discount is applied automatically (`applyMemberDiscount: false` to skip).

item.name: 5. Prescription
item.description: Upload a photo of the paper prescription. In the Postman app, choose any image for the "images" field if the sample file is not found.

request.description: multipart/form-data: up to 10 images (15 MB each) in `images`, plus `appointmentId`, `diagnosis?`, `advice?`, `nextVisitDate?` (YYYY-MM-DD).
